# Pradip Machine Tools

> Plastic injection mould manufacturer in Odhav, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Established 1986 by Fulchand G. Malvi. Mould design, VMC and EDM machining, 3D printed samples, mould trials and injection moulding production, all under one roof.

Pradip Machine Tools designs and builds custom plastic injection moulds and runs them in production. Moulds built here and running in production include tower fans, 12 litre pedal dustbins, PPR and SWR pipe fittings, a Honda Activa 3G front inner panel, a rider toy car, a CPR training manikin, thin wall food containers, a 500 ml square food container on hot runner, a 30-piece transport egg tray, and multi-cavity and unscrewing cap moulds.

The company serves customers across India and welcomes export enquiries.

## Mould categories

- [Thinwall container moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/thinwall-container/): food containers, cutlery, egg trays, caps
- [Automobile moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/automobile-mould/): panels and components, two-wheeler inner panels
- [Pipe fittings moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/pipe-fittings-mould/): PPR and SWR fittings
- [Household products moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/household-products-mould/)
- [Home appliance moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/home-appliance-mould/)
- [Toys moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/toys-mould/)
- [Electronic component moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/electronic-component-mould/)
- [Insert moulds](https://pradipmachinetools.com/products/insert-mould/)

## Capability

- Mould systems: cold runner and hot runner
- Mould steels: P-20, 1.2311, 1.2738, H-13, D-2
- In house: product and mould design, VMC machining, EDM, FDM 3D printed samples, mould trials, injection moulding production
- Output: 8 to 9 moulds a month
- History: founded 1986; water tap moulds through 1996 to 2006; VMC added in 2011

## How to start

Send a part drawing, a 3D file or a sample. Pradip Machine Tools studies the part, suggests changes where needed and gives a costing. The product is modelled in 3D, the mould designed around it, an FDM sample printed for approval, the core and cavity machined on the VMC and detailed on the EDM, then the mould is trialled and run in production.

Useful details to send with an enquiry: part volume or size, wall thickness, resin, annual quantity and the moulding machine the mould will run on.
